messages:
Marta (Marketing): Quick thread for tomorrow's launch timeline and comms — need final sign-offs on blog copy, embargo window, press list, partner preview, and CTAs. Looping Legal and Product.

Ajay (PR): Press tracker updated: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1presslist (col G = embargo). Will assemble embargoed pitch after Legal confirms language.

Noah (Growth): Partners asked for an early look. Proposal: private preview at T-12h (read-only link), Braze partner send at T-1h. Template is queued.

Claire (Product): CMS publish set for 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC. Confirm embargo lift at that time. Also need the final CEO one-liner for the header.

Sam (Legal): Read PR copy. Two small items: remove absolute claims like "zero latency" and add the DPA link for EU customers. I'll post exact phrasing in the doc.

Ajay (PR): Quick ops question: distribute full benchmark PDF to embargoed press at T-1h or hold until T=0?

Marta (Marketing): Give embargoed press the PDF at T-1h with a "for embargoed review only" note. Partner preview at T-12h should be lighter (no full PDFs).

Noah (Growth): Sounds good. Public CTA = "Get started — free credits". Partners CTA = "Affiliate login / tracking". I'll set tracking params.

Claire (Product): Ops note: we'll flip the GA flag at 16:55 UTC to warm caches — do not publish before 17:00 UTC. Rollback plan: auto-fallback to model v1.2 if errors spike.

Marta (Marketing): @deploy-bot can you confirm the GA flag schedule?

deploy-bot: Scheduled: GA flag flip at 2026-04-01T16:55:00Z. Publish lock until 2026-04-01T17:00:00Z.

Sam (Legal): Added DPA link and adjusted CEO quote in the PR doc. Ajay, please confirm before outreach.

Ajay (PR): Done — PR doc updated (DPA link, legal-approved quote, benchmark summary). I'll queue embargoed outreach at T-1h and wide send at T=0.

Marta (Marketing): Social assets are in Drive (/social/launch-ready). I'll schedule organic posts for T=0, paid promos at T+1h.

Claire (Product): Ops will monitor latency and error rate for 30 minutes post-launch. If error rate >1% we will trigger rollback.

Marta (Marketing): Action items: Ajay: embargo outreach T-1h and public send T=0; Sam: confirm legal edits live; Noah: partner preview T-12h and Braze T-1h; Claire/Ops: GA flag at 16:55 & rollback ready; Marta: finalize CMS copy + social. Reconvene T-14h for a 10-min greenlight. Drop blockers here. :thumbsup:
